title: Its OK
text:
Its OK. I want to like these. I hate throwing away plastic bags. But honestly, I didn't like them as much as I hoped. I wanted to store ground coffee in one of the bags, but I noticed a plastic smell out of the box that I didn't want in my coffee. Washing the bag and letting it air out inside-out seemed to help, and after a few days I can say the bag now doesn't smell but I'm still wary of storing coffee in it. For things like storing cheese or sandwiches, I'd be ok with it. But it brings me to my next issue: Washing and drying plastic is hard to do without growing mold! You have to make sure you turn these really inside-out in order to get it to fully dry, and it could take a day or two to fully dry out enough that you can turn it back rightside-in to reuse.
At the end of the day, I don't think I'll be replacing disposable bags with this. But it's a good proof-of-concept at least.
